prompt:
Edit this ENTIRE exact game diffuse source UV canvas into a very modest HD painted version. The reference is made ONLY by native storedRGB converted to opaqueRGB and nearest-enlarged WHOLE original canvas. Return exactly the same entire source aspect and every source normalized UV position, part dimension/outline, sourcepaint region count, weak local mark, gap, pattern phase and grain scale. No crop, padding, frame, whitespace, zoom, fitting, rotation, rearrangement or newly visible component. Original source alpha restored separately by coordinator; source black is existing source shadowcolor, not new physical hardware.

Native128x64 source consists of EXACTLY FIVE original matte fine-grained brown painted regions: one large left polygon, one upper-right broad brown field, one lower-middle tapered brown field and two smaller lower-right rounded brown fields. Preserve their exact original shapes/positions/dimensions, original soft unequal shaded boundaries, and original black gaps. These are painted bitmap regions; do not interpret them into new3Dcap/rivet/brick geometry, rims, holes or bevels. The large left and upper-right fields remain very dark brown with source fine soft speckles and slight shading; keep the original very weak material contrast and native grain scale. Lower smaller regions preserve their original subdued lighter brown relationships and fine mottling without larger spots, swirls, fibers, highlights or new objects.

Only gently resolve existing subdued matte fine paint. Keep the original gray/warm palette, local source light relationships and broad shading. Fine lightpaint stays faint paint, never a white raised rim, new gloss, glinty capped rod, bevel/hardware or coarse mottled surface. Original soft edges stay soft, irregular patterns remain irregular. No added part, hole, rivet, fastener, bolt, thread, crack, woodgrain, weave, scratch, photographic noise, thick ridge, sharp diamond, stronger glare, lensreflection, lettering, new symbol or curl. Output the ENTIRE opaque source canvas at exact original aspect and layout. The result will be resized only as one entire image to original4x; no sourceRGB artistic inserts.
